description draft：

## Description

Increase `num_workers` in dataloader from 4 to 8 to improve data loading throughput.

### Context
- Machine has 12 CPU cores, previous test with num_workers=4 was stable (24 Sep).
- With 4 workers, data loading became a bottleneck in large-scale experiments (e.g., environment 4 multiple seeds).
- Bumping to 8 should better utilize available CPU cores and reduce idle GPU time.

### Risk
- If CPU cores get overloaded or memory pressure increases, may cause instability. Monitor GPU utilization after merge; rollback to 4 if needed.
